description: [LTX Studio](https://ltx.dev/studio), developed by Lightricks, introduces LTX 2.3, the first real-time AI video generation model based on Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architecture. This professional-grade tool allows users to transform text descriptions or reference images into high-quality video content in as little as 2 to 4 seconds. By bridging the gap between creative vision and cinematic execution, [it](https://ltx.dev) provides a streamlined workflow for rapid digital storytelling. Advanced
